summary: Camarines Sur 3rd District representative with 149 principal-authored bills. Authored a VAT cut to 10 percent, hazard pay in critical private industries, a Magna Carta for barangay health workers and 14 days of paternity leave.
caveat: Only four rubric bills surfaced from 149, so evidence may be incomplete.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored hazard pay and 14-day paternity leave (-2, labor) and a Magna Carta for barangay health workers (-2), offset by a VAT cut to 10 percent (+2, taxes).
